title: New Stable version immediately crashes
body:
Immediately after upgrading to new stable build the app will not open. Upon tapping the app icon, the app launches a black background, then an error opens saying xDrip+ has stopped.
Included is the crash report generated from adb logcat.

Device is LG G4
Android Version is 6.0.0

[xdrip_crash.txt](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/files/2411697/xdrip_crash.txt)
.

comments.body:
Thanks for reporting this with detail. This issue only affects LG Android 6 phones. I'm not sure if it is a bug in the LG framework or the android drawable support library.

I may be able to resolve it with a work-around. Until then I would suggest simply installing the previous version of xDrip you had. (You can just install an old version over the top of the new one) and I will notify you as soon as I have a newer version to test.
Can you try the 26th Sept nightly and let me know if this resolves the issue? Thanks.

Unfortunately the issue was not fixed, the app still crashes on startup. I however have noticed that the app will start itself up in the background shortly after it crashes (a few minutes) and continue to take readings. Here is the crash log from starting up the 26th Sep nightly. Let me know if you need anything else.

[debug.txt](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/files/2427952/debug.txt)

Thanks for all the help.
Please can you try the 28th Sept nightly which is available now. I added a new attempt to fix the problem.

Success!
The new build launches the app without any crashes or errors. Seems to work as normal - no issues found.

Thanks for your help and hard work.
